code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD disable auto transactions
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::disable_auto_transactions
       Disables automatic transactions for the current transaction.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::disable_auto_transactions

DESCRIPTION
       Disables automatic transactions for the current transaction.

RETURN VALUE
       Disables automatic transactions for the current transaction.

VALID DURING
       HTTP_REQUEST

EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	    if { [HTTP::header exists "Antifraud-Disable-AutoTransactions" ] } {
		ANTIFRAUD::disable_auto_transactions
		log local0. "Automatic Transactions disabled"
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
